publisher: Washington State Department of Children, Youth, and Families

official_sources.evidence: DCYF publishes Licensed Childcare Center and School Age Program Providers as active license and facility information at extraction time.
The Washington open-data platform exposes a supported queryable resource; discovery used metadata and count-only requests and acquired no provider rows.
DCYF describes Child Care Check as the public pathway for licensed status, history, monitoring, and provider search.
Child Care Check searches by provider name, provider ID, phone, city, or ZIP and describes itself as Washington's licensed child-care status and record database.

scope.warning: Active license extract membership, facility type, license dates, monitoring history, provider identity, and current business operation are separate assertions.

temporal.limitation: Catalog update time and active-license extract membership do not prove continuous operation, current public access, or license state after extraction.

retained_metadata_observation.catalog_name: DCYF Licensed Childcare Center and School Age Program Providers

next_action: Validate a zero-provider-row schema and bounded selected projection contract that excludes contact and shipping fields; then implement metadata drift, fixed-field pagination, identifier conservation, temporal semantics, ZIP5/ZIP+4 separation, and policy review before authorizing acquisition.
